paths.name: lodash-es
paths.message: Use lodash instead. The bundler is configured to use lodash-es automatically.

patterns.message: Use RhMicron, RhUi, or RhStandard icon variants instead of Font Awesome icons.
Import from the package index instead of the CJS dist path.
Use the useSyncExternalStore shim from 'react' instead of importing the polyfill.

jest/no-restricted-matchers.toMatchSnapshot: Do not use toMatchSnapshot(); use explicit assertions (e.g. toStrictEqual on focused objects, getByRole, etc.).
jest/no-restricted-matchers.toMatchInlineSnapshot: Do not use toMatchInlineSnapshot(); use explicit assertions instead.
jest/no-restricted-matchers.toThrowErrorMatchingSnapshot: Do not use toThrowErrorMatchingSnapshot(); assert on error message or type explicitly.
jest/no-restricted-matchers.toThrowErrorMatchingInlineSnapshot: Do not use toThrowErrorMatchingInlineSnapshot(); assert on error message or type explicitly.
